title: Phone Mockup
summary: A floating iPhone beside the speaker shows an app conversation that types itself out.
description: An iPhone (titanium frame, dynamic island, status bar) springs in beside the speaker's head with a slight 3D tilt and soft shadow, and the footage pans a little the other way so the face stays clear. Inside, a dark chat-assistant app plays out: a message, a typing indicator, a recommendation card with stat tiles, then a finger tap on the main button that turns it green and triggers a reply. Swap the chat for your own screenshot or screen recording with "screen".

options.size: phone width as a fraction of the frame width (0.3-0.4)
options.y: "auto" (level with the head) or a 0-1 fraction for the phone's top edge
options.tilt: 3D tilt in degrees (0 = flat facing camera)
options.nudge: "auto" pans the footage away from the phone so the face isn't covered, or a 0-0.12 fraction of the frame width (0 = no pan)
options.app.name: app name in the header
options.app.status: line under the app name (e.g. Online)
options.card.label: small tracked label on the card
options.card.title: the card's headline (1-2 short lines)
options.card.tiles: up to 3 stat tiles: [{"label": "Ad 1", "value": 0.9, "color": "#6FD38A"}] (value 0-1 = bar fill); [] hides them
options.button: primary button label that gets tapped
options.secondary: secondary text next to the button ("" hides it)
options.reply: reply bubble that appears after the tap ("" for none)
options.screen: optional image or video file shown on the screen instead of the chat UI
options.inAt: when the phone flies in (seconds or "@word")
options.messageAt: "auto" or when the first message appears
options.cardAt: "auto" (about 30% in) or when the card appears
options.tapAt: "auto" (on words like approve/click/tap/done, else ~65% in) or when the button is tapped
options.outAt: optional: when the phone flies back out (null = stays)
